"""Image shape spot-checks (semantic coverage lives in test_semantics.py)."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

DENY = 4294967295
SVC = [{"name": "A", "label": 10}, {"name": "B", "label": 4}, {"name": "C", "label": 7}]
# cols: B=0, C=1, A=2

def stage(policy, services=SVC, limits=None):
    r = run_cli(req([job(services, [{"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": policy}], limits)]))
    return r["results"][0]["events"][0]

def img_of(policy, services=SVC):
    return stage(policy, services)["image"]

e = stage("match(A) drop;")
check("empty language (drop only)", e,
      {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "image": {"accept": [False], "rows": [[DENY]*3]}})
e = stage("")
check("empty policy", e,
      {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "image": {"accept": [False], "rows": [[DENY]*3]}})
e = stage("contains() allow;")
check("all allow", e,
      {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "image": {"accept": [True], "rows": [[0, 0, 0]]}})
e = stage("match(A) allow; match(A) drop;")
check("drop beats allow same word", e,
      {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "image": {"accept": [False], "rows": [[DENY]*3]}})
im = img_of("match(A,B) allow;")
check("match A,B BFS", im, {"accept": [False, False, True],
      "rows": [[DENY, DENY, 1], [2, DENY, DENY], [DENY]*3]})
im = img_of("match() allow;")
check("match() only epsilon", im, {"accept": [True], "rows": [[DENY]*3]})
im = img_of("startswith(A) allow;")
check("startswith A", im, {"accept": [False, True],
      "rows": [[DENY, DENY, 1], [1, 1, 1]]})
im = img_of("endswith(B) allow;")
check("endswith B", im, {"accept": [False, True],
      "rows": [[1, 0, 0], [1, 0, 0]]})
im = img_of("contains(A,B) allow;")
check("contains A,B minimal", im, {"accept": [False, False, True],
      "rows": [[0, 0, 1], [2, 0, 1], [2, 2, 2]]})
im = img_of("((match(A) or match(B)) and not(match(B))) allow;")
check("or/and/not", im, {"accept": [False, True],
      "rows": [[DENY, DENY, 1], [DENY]*3]})
im = img_of("match(A) allow; match(B) allow;")
check("two words BFS order", im, {"accept": [False, True, True],
      "rows": [[2, DENY, 1], [DENY]*3, [DENY]*3]})
im = img_of("match(A,A) allow; match(B,A) allow;")
check("merge suffix states", im, {"accept": [False, False, True],
      "rows": [[DENY, DENY, 1], [2, DENY, 1], [DENY]*3]})
e = stage("match(Z) allow;")
check("unregistered name", e, {"error": "rejected"})
e = stage("match(A allow;")
check("syntax error", e, {"error": "rejected"})
e = stage("match(A)\x0ballow;")
check("vertical tab", e, {"error": "rejected"})
e = stage("contains(A,B,C,A,B) allow;")
check("nonmatch path 5", e, {"error": "rejected"})
e = stage("match(" + ",".join(["A"]*17) + ") allow;")
check("match path 17", e, {"error": "rejected"})
im = img_of("match(C) allow;", services=SVC)
check("col order by label", im, {"accept": [False, True], "rows": [[DENY, 1, DENY], [DENY]*3]})
im = img_of("((match(A) or match(B)) allow); ((startswith(A) or startswith(B)) drop); contains() allow;")
check("drop startswith beats", im, {"accept": [False], "rows": [[DENY]*3]})
im = img_of("match() drop; contains() allow;")
check("eps dropped from all", im, {"accept": [False, True],
      "rows": [[DENY, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1]]})
im = img_of("(startswith(A) and endswith(B)) allow;")
check("prefix and suffix", im, {"accept": [False, False, False, True],
      "rows": [[DENY, DENY, 1, DENY], [1, 1, 2, 1], [DENY, DENY, 3, DENY], [1, 1, 2, 1]]})
summary()
EOF
cd /workspace && timeout 400 python3 tests/test_images.py
